dct_title_s: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines La Soufriere Volcano: Damage Proxy Maps, Apr 2021
dct_description_sm: # Saint Vincent and the Grenadines La Soufriere Volcano: Damage Proxy Maps, Apr 2021 The Advanced Rapid Imaging and Analysis (ARIA) team at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory and Caltech, in collaboration with the Earth Observatory of Singapore (EOS), produced these damage proxy maps for Saint Vincent and the Grenadines La Soufriere Volcano (Apr 2021) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images.
